description:
The hotel was built in 1903 on a hill above the spa town of Mariánské Lázně (Marienbad), surrounded by the Slavkov Forest, and in its early years it attracted a well-off clientele.

It changed owners several times between 1920 and 1991, when its last private investor abandoned it, and the building stood closed for many years. According to hotel listings, a new owner bought it in 2008 and a complete reconstruction that kept its original character reopened it in 2015.

The grounds contain a statue of Rübezahl, the mountain spirit of Central European legend whose name the hotel carries. Today it operates as a five-star hotel with a spa and a restaurant, free parking and breakfast included on the rate seen.

faqs.question: When was the Rübezahl-Marienbad hotel built?
faqs.answer: The Czech tourist board dates it to 1903, on a hill above Mariánské Lázně.

faqs.question: Why is it called Rübezahl?
faqs.answer: It takes the name of Rübezahl, a mountain spirit of Central European legend, whose statue stands in the hotel's grounds.

hotel.how_to_stay:
**Getting there:** On a wooded hill above Mariánské Lázně in the Karlovy Vary Region; Booking lists free private parking and a ski-to-door location.

**Rooms & rates:** From approx. €177/night for a 22 m² Double Room with a queen bed, a garden view, air conditioning, a private bathroom, a flat-screen TV, a minibar and free Wi-Fi, with breakfast, one parking spot and high-speed internet included and free cancellation on the rate seen; taxes included. A Junior Double was around €196 and a Double Superior around €256.

**On-site:** A spa with a hammam, sauna and massage, a restaurant, free parking and a wooded setting; the grounds include a statue of Rübezahl.

**Good to know:** Rates were seen for one February 2027 stay, a low-season date, so check your own dates on Booking. The hotel was rebuilt as a hotel in 2015, so the interior is a modern reconstruction of a 1903 building.

**Combine with:** [More castle hotels in Czech Republic](/castle-hotels/czech-republic).
